Identity mode, and fewer reads of the save records.

## Server

### Added
- A vanilla identity mode. The default keys every remote player's save under an id derived from their name so that several players with the same blank platform id keep separate characters. Vanilla leaves the game's own identity flow untouched: every blank-id player shares the game's single blank profile, exactly as the game behaves without this runtime. It is the right mode for a one-player world while the synthetic keying is proven against the game's own save path. Set by a file the hoster controls: `SolarpunkServer\data\identity-mode.txt` containing the word `vanilla`. At boot in vanilla mode the first record under the blank id is the profile, and any other record carrying the same last seen name is retired so the game's name-keyed follow-up cannot bind the client to a different inventory. The boot log prints `identity mode: ...`.

### Changed
- The save records are no longer read on every scheduler tick. The host crashed a fourth time inside the mod loader during a session with heavy save traffic, and the per-tick record repair added in v0.1.79 was the one new reader in that window. The repair still runs before each save, before each swap and at boot.
